tools.name: avalanche_coverage
tools.description: Is there an avalanche report at all right now, and in which regions? Lists every warning region in the Alps with a current report, grouped by warning service, with validity. Off season most regions have none. Contains no danger levels: use avalanche_bulletin for those.

tools.name: avalanche_region
tools.description: Does a summit, destination or point lie in an avalanche warning region of the Alps, in which one, and does it have a current report? Takes the name of a place or of a region, or up to 20 points such as start and summit of a tour. Also names other regions within 2 km.

tools.name: avalanche_overview
tools.description: How is the avalanche situation in a wider area of the Alps, such as Tyrol or the Valais? Give the name of a place or warning region, or lat and lon, with an optional radius, or a warning service. Returns every report for the area with its danger levels per elevation, avalanche problems and main mess

tools.name: avalanche_bulletin
tools.description: The danger level where someone is going in the Alps, from the official avalanche bulletin: give a place name or the name of a warning region, or lat and lon, or a region id. The elevation of a named place or point is looked up unless you give elevationM. atPlace holds the level for that elevation an

description: The weather forecast at a place in the Alps, for its elevation: weather, precipitation, fresh snow, freezing level, temperature, wind and gusts, sunshine and thunderstorm risk, in six-hour periods of local time for up to ten days. Computed from several weather models like the forecast in the topo^al

description.name: station_observations
description.description: What the weather stations near a place in the Alps measure now: temperature, snow depth, fresh snow, wind and gusts, each with the time of the measurement, and optionally the last days. Measured, not forecast, at the place and elevation of the station. Stations are chosen by distance and elevation d

description.name: mountain_huts
description.description: The mountain huts nearest to a place in the Alps, or to where the user stands: name, distance and direction in a straight line, elevation and the difference to the place, mountain hut or self-catering, operator, beds and contact, as far as OpenStreetMap has them. Not opening times, free places or pr

description.name: winter_tours
description.description: Ski and snowshoe tours in the Alps at a place: the routes up to a summit, hut or pass, and the routes that start in a valley or at a hut. Each with title, grade in the scale of the language, elevation gain, length, and the start seen from the place. From the guidebook and portal data shown in the to

description.name: tour_terrain
description.description: The terrain of one ski or snowshoe tour in the Alps, by the id from winter_tours: how steep it is and for how long, the aspects of the steep slopes, how much lies in avalanche terrain (ATES and ATM), stretch by stretch, and the grade explained with the words of the SAC scale and who gave it. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "avalanche_overview" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "station_observations" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: query, placeId, lat, lon, elevationM, radiusKm, limit, history, lang

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "avalanche_overview" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
